summary: AAP isn't supported with `fapolicyd` enforcing, and the installer's pre-flight check stops if it is. Set `permissive = 1` in `/etc/fapolicyd/fapolicyd.conf` and run `sudo systemctl restart fapolicyd.service` on AAP servers and on the installation host.
questions: AAP installer fails because fapolicyd is enforcing
How do I set fapolicyd to permissive for AAP?
Is fapolicyd supported with Ansible Automation Platform?

answer_card.title: Set fapolicyd to permissive
answer_card.answer_md:
On every AAP server (and the installation host):
```ini
# /etc/fapolicyd/fapolicyd.conf
permissive = 1
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart fapolicyd.service
```
AAP isn't supported while fapolicyd enforces policy, and the installer pre-flight check halts on it.
